{"sample\_id": "KNS-x", "component": "K2O", "value": 50.0, "unit": "mol"},
{"sample\_id": "KNS-x", "component": "Nb2O5", "value": x, "unit": "mol"},
{"sample\_id": "KNS-x", "component": "Si O2", "value": (100.0 - 50.0 - x), "unit": "mol"}

These lines should be generated for each value of x in the range 0 to 0.35. The resulting JSON lines represent the composition of each KNS glass sample in terms of mol% of K2O, Nb2O5, and Si O2.
